questions.question_text: Priya borrows $\$22\,400$ for a kitchen renovation at $0.9\%$ per month, repaid by $30$ equal monthly instalments. The table gives the present value of an annuity of $\$1$ per period. $\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Period } (n) & 0.8\% & 0.9\% & 1\% \\ \hline 30 & 26.5776 & 26.1887 & 25.8077\\ 36 & 31.1723 & 30.6334 & 30.1075 \\ \hline \end{array}$ Her monthly repayment is $\$855.33$. What is the total amount of interest charged over the life of the loan? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

options.why: Reported the total amount repaid and forgot to subtract the $\$22\,400$ borrowed.
Counted only $29$ repayments instead of $30$, an off-by-one error in the term.
Applied simple interest $22\,400 \times 0.009 \times 30$ to the full principal, ignoring that the balance reduces.

Calculate the total interest paid over the life of the loan, to the nearest cent.
